extraction.notes: Three-month column for Dec 31, 2025 taken from the FFO table (seq 11; the same figures repeat on seq 16). Shares printed as 66,675,698 and divided by 1,000 to 66,675.698 thousand; check: 262,977/66,675.698 = $3.94 and 265,146/66,675.698 = $3.98. The company reports no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null and no recurring capex was found on these pages. Two lines printed as '-' are recorded as 0. The 'Depreciation attributable to third party ownership and other' line (-38) was classified as re_depreciation, which is a judgment call. The 'Impairment loss from unconsolidated co-investments' line was classified as re_impairment, which is also a judgment call since the co-investment asset type is not stated. Page printed numbers: the seq 11 page has no printed number in the marker, while seq 16 is marked printed '3' (text shows S-3).
